headline: Cheviot confirms SEBI-compliant demat processes for the September quarter
summary: Cheviot has officially confirmed that its demat processes comply with SEBI regulations for the quarter ending September. The filing is a standard regulatory update submitted by the company. Such periodic compliances are mandatory for listed entities on Indian stock exchanges. Retail investors can view this as routine administrative disclosure without immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock value.
